notes: `data.write(to: installerJar, options: [.atomic])` -- the downloaded bytes land in the server directory itself (not a temp dir elsewhere), under a fixed filename `forge-installer.jar`, so a second call before cleanup would overwrite rather than collide. The install(mcVersion:forgeVersion:) overload logs 'Downloading Forge {version} installer...' instead (version-specific), same write behavior otherwise.
